Nurse Attacked with Acid and Machete by Husband in Bengaluru

A nurse from Kolkata was attacked with acid and a machete by her husband in a public area of J.P. Nagar, Bengaluru. The incident occurred in broad daylight, with the husband reportedly chasing down the victim before assaulting her. Authorities have initiated an investigation into the attack.
